title: Thornment
summary: Thornment, one of several mummy-like Hecto-Titans, inspired the mythology of ancient Egypt. Within her wraps, Thornment is a mass of living, thorny vines, which she is able to expertly control as extensions of her own being. Whether whipping, slicing, tying, or tripping, Thornment is a powerful foe. One Thornment was the primary Titan of Rassimov.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: Thornment was a powerful Titan used by ancient Egyptian pharaohs. To her enemies, Thornment was a deadly foe as hidden within her linen wraps was a mass of living, purple, thorny vines. {{source|Huntik.com}}

sections.heading: Rassimov's Thornment
sections.text:
Rassimov possessed a Thornment Amulet and used this Titan in his missions for the Organization against the Huntik Foundation.

In the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, Rassimov used Thornment to save Dante Vale from some Ghost Traps. Later on, Thornment fought and defeated Lok Lambert's Hoplite. [Memory Lane]

While searching for the Legendary Titan of Body, Behemoth, Thornment was invoked alongside Kopesh to attack Dante's Caliban. Thornment was defeated when Caliban swung her into Kopesh. [Ladies' Choice]

At the Temple of Poseidon, Thornment attacked Caliban but was overpowered and defeated. [The Unseen Guide] Rassimov later invoked Thornment in Atlantis alongside Kopesh to attack Lok's Lindorm. Thornment attacked Baselaird with her vines but, after being dragged into the crossfire, was defeated by a misfired Hopeshatter blast from Rassimov. [Coming of Age]

Thornment fought and defeated Caliban in the Professor's castle. She chased Dante but was defeated by Dante's Touchram power. [The Divine Comedy]

Rassimov used Thornment to entangle one of Klaus' Suits at the Tomb of Nefertiti while searching for the Necklace of Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt. Later, Thornment's bond with Rassimov was broken by Dante Vale's Sorrowbond spell, and her Amulet was taken into custody by Huntik Foundation agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

sections.heading: Rahmas' Thornment
sections.wikitext: One of Rassimov's former agents, [[Rahmas]] invoked a Thornment Titan to fight and defeat Lok's [[Freelancer]] while searching for the Amulet of [[Cerberus]]. [[Sophie Casterwill]]'s [[Sabriel]] then attacked and defeated Thornment by throwing a sword at her. {{Source|Cerberus (Comic)|Cerberus}}

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S1E18 Hoplite Thornment.jpg|thumb|Thornment uses her vines to defeat a [[Hoplite]]]]
Thornment has the ability to slice, grab, coil, whip, stab and trip enemies with her thorny vines. This makes her a dangerous enemy and useful for setting up ambushes. She has been seen fighting power houses like [[Caliban]] and [[Sabriel]] and even outmatched them on some occasions. However, she is generally easy to take out, being sent back to her amulet after a single [[Touchram]] spell from [[Dante Vale]] (albeit after fighting [[Caliban]] for a while).

full_text:
Thornment, one of several mummy-like Hecto-Titans, inspired the mythology of ancient Egypt. Within her wraps, Thornment is a mass of living, thorny vines, which she is able to expertly control as extensions of her own being. Whether whipping, slicing, tying, or tripping, Thornment is a powerful foe. One Thornment was the primary Titan of Rassimov.

History

Thornment was a powerful Titan used by ancient Egyptian pharaohs. To her enemies, Thornment was a deadly foe as hidden within her linen wraps was a mass of living, purple, thorny vines. [Huntik.com]

Rassimov's Thornment

Rassimov possessed a Thornment Amulet and used this Titan in his missions for the Organization against the Huntik Foundation.

In the Mausoleum of Sir Lancelot, Rassimov used Thornment to save Dante Vale from some Ghost Traps. Later on, Thornment fought and defeated Lok Lambert's Hoplite. [Memory Lane]

While searching for the Legendary Titan of Body, Behemoth, Thornment was invoked alongside Kopesh to attack Dante's Caliban. Thornment was defeated when Caliban swung her into Kopesh. [Ladies' Choice]

At the Temple of Poseidon, Thornment attacked Caliban but was overpowered and defeated. [The Unseen Guide] Rassimov later invoked Thornment in Atlantis alongside Kopesh to attack Lok's Lindorm. Thornment attacked Baselaird with her vines but, after being dragged into the crossfire, was defeated by a misfired Hopeshatter blast from Rassimov. [Coming of Age]

Thornment fought and defeated Caliban in the Professor's castle. She chased Dante but was defeated by Dante's Touchram power. [The Divine Comedy]

Rassimov used Thornment to entangle one of Klaus' Suits at the Tomb of Nefertiti while searching for the Necklace of Tutankhamun in the Valley of the Kings, Egypt. Later, Thornment's bond with Rassimov was broken by Dante Vale's Sorrowbond spell, and her Amulet was taken into custody by Huntik Foundation agents. [Rassimov's Secret]

Rahmas' Thornment

One of Rassimov's former agents, Rahmas invoked a Thornment Titan to fight and defeat Lok's Freelancer while searching for the Amulet of Cerberus. Sophie Casterwill's Sabriel then attacked and defeated Thornment by throwing a sword at her. [Cerberus]

Abilities

Image caption: Thornment uses her vines to defeat a Hoplite

Thornment has the ability to slice, grab, coil, whip, stab and trip enemies with her thorny vines. This makes her a dangerous enemy and useful for setting up ambushes. She has been seen fighting power houses like Caliban and Sabriel and even outmatched them on some occasions. However, she is generally easy to take out, being sent back to her amulet after a single Touchram spell from Dante Vale (albeit after fighting Caliban for a while).
